region.name_my: ချင်းပြည်နယ်

scope: Remaining 12 states and regions; excludes previously generated Ayeyarwady and Bago, and excludes Nay Pyi Taw Union Territory.
administrative_basis: Primarily the expanded 2022 district framework. Administrative listings differ; this is not a verified live boundary or territorial-control dataset. Self-administered zones are listed separately, not relabelled as districts.
crop_fit_basis: Preliminary agro-ecological and state/region-level candidate shortlists, not verified district-level best-crop rankings.
limitations: Crop lists do not establish profitability, current cultivation, yield potential or parcel-level suitability.
Many entries extrapolate regional farming systems rather than district-specific studies.
Verify local crop history, soil, slope, salinity, drainage, irrigation, season and market access.
Assess current security, land tenure, explosive-ordnance risk and safe field access locally before any activity.
A null primary_crop_fit means no broad-acre recommendation was assigned, not that all cultivation is impossible.

districts.name_my: ဖလမ်းခရိုင်
districts.primary_crop_fit: Rice on suitable lowland or established upland fields
districts.conditions_and_caveats: Hill-region shortlist only, not district-specific evidence. Elevation, slope, soil depth, erosion risk and local growing season can rule out either crop; no forest conversion.
